reflections.summary: Temporal: one anchor per sentence, other events hang off it with :overlap, every event gets a parent, no depends-on for vague present adverbs, copular identity left out. Classifiers become :quant+:unit (also 1); adverbs are nodes. No implicit arguments. Attachment rules for aspectual-verb relatives, shared modifiers, describing clauses, part-of and medium. Aspect rules for habitual, already+stop and naming passives. Prefer lexical frames over -91; 不过 is but-91; have-degree-91; 由于 is :reason; split coordinated compounds. No :wiki, title brackets as ops, place-name modifiers as :place. No coref chains for incidental place modifiers.

Fix temporal anchoring (identity-91 root, aspectual verbs, past-time adverbs, result-now depends-on, have-degree-91 exception), superlative ARG2/ARG5 and 上 postposition, Chinese PropBank role numbering, attributes on identity-91/have-degree-91, shared-subject re-entrancy, fused negation, narrowed already+stop rule, nested and-pairs, coref checklist.

Fix misleading belonging-verb sense example and make PropBank frame lookup (whole token, all senses) mandatory; specify concept for fused negation; specific periodical entity types; explicit identity-91 temporal triples; stative verbs keep state aspect; no unexpressed non-core relations.

Reify clause-level reason/purpose (have-reason-91/have-purpose-91); split verb+量/率/额 compounds and use have-quant-91 for amounts reached; bare-verb frame for V至/V到 tokens; widen Chinese ARG0-theme warning; narrow shared-subject re-entrancy, head-noun/appositive/旗下 rules; individual-person, middle-dot op, agent nouns; fix temporal rules for absolute dates, purpose, cause/earlier relatives, depends-on, decade; aspect/modal/coref details.

Keep the reach/fall verb as root (ARG0 theme, performance) with have-quant-91 attribute-free; no sentence-initial one-arg but-91; measure-compound inner verb without aspect/modal; format/part noun as argument with publication :part-of, A in 由A改为B is ARG1; trailing contains-clauses as ARGn-of process; role noun with name -> role predicate (Chinese -91 names, per critique); nested abstract predicates get no aspect/temporal/modal; date :overlap event; earlier-sentence anchoring only when sequence marked; :era year number; printing example.

Define entities at first mention and re-enter later; part-of only (no inverse :part), for any part/format argument; enforce ARG0-only rolesets (checklist); no node for a connective linking to an earlier sentence; stricter :same-event; narrative change defaults to :overlap; trailing clause attaches to the creation verb's own argument. Trimmed intro/header text to stay under the limit.
